prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you need someone for a home (residential irrigation/well) or for a business (commercial fire line, restaurant, etc.)? If you tell me your ZIP code I can make the search suggestions more specific.

In the meantime, here are quick, practical steps to find a qualified backflow tester/repairer near Liberty, MO and to vet them:

Where to look
- Contact the City of Liberty Utilities / Water Department. Many cities keep a list of certified backflow testers or can tell you how to submit test results.
- Search Google Maps, Yelp, Angi (Angie’s List), HomeAdvisor or the BBB for “backflow testing,” “backflow prevention,” “cross-connection control” or “backflow repair” near Liberty, MO / Kansas City metro.
- Call local plumbing contractors, irrigation companies, and fire-protection contractors — they commonly do backflow testing and repairs.

What to check before hiring
- Certification: Ask for the tester’s backflow tester certification (ask for certificate or certification number) and that it’s current. Many local authorities require certified testers for annual tests.
- Licensing and insurance: Confirm the company is licensed to work in Missouri and carries liability insurance.
- Experience & references: Ask how long they’ve done backflow testing and for references, especially for similar residential/commercial work.
- Reporting: Ask if they will file the test results with the City of Liberty (some cities require online submission by the tester).
- Written estimate: Get a written estimate for the test and any potential repairs. Ask for parts brands/warranty.
- Price: Typical residential test fees often run in the ~$50–$150 range; repairs depend on parts/labor and can vary widely (give this as a ballpark only).

Sample search queries (paste into Google or Maps)
- backflow tester near Liberty MO
- backflow testing Liberty MO
- backflow repair Kansas City
- certified backflow tester Clay County MO

Short phone/email script you can use
- Hi — I need annual backflow testing/inspection for my [residential irrigation / commercial fire line] at [address or ZIP]. Are you certified to test backflow assemblies in Missouri? Can you provide your tester certification number and do you file test results with the City of Liberty? Do you have availability this week and what’s your price for testing? If repairs are needed, can you provide a written estimate?

If you want, give me your ZIP code and whether it’s residential or commercial and I’ll suggest specific search results and a short list of likely local contractor types to call.
